card.summary: The A Stronger Workforce for America Act of 2026 reauthorizes and updates the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA). The legislation sets funding levels for various workforce development programs, transfers adult education and family literacy functions to the Department of Labor, modifies state and local workforce boards and plans, changes performance accountability metrics, revises the training provider eligibility process, introduces new grant programs, and establishes pilot projects.
